name: Cementerio de la Recoleta
desc: A marble city of the dead where Evita rests and cats patrol the alleys. Gothic, gorgeous, worth the ticket.

name: Caminito
desc: La Boca's candy-colored tin houses with tango dancers working the corners. Loudest free photo op in South America.

name: Teatro Colón
desc: One of the world's great opera houses. Take the tour now, promise yourself the box seats later.

name: Plaza de Mayo
desc: The pink palace, the mothers' scarves painted on stone, two centuries of history in one free square.

name: Feria de San Telmo
desc: Sunday antiques stretching for blocks: old soda siphons, tango vinyl, street bands. Browsing is the whole sport.

name: Bosques de Palermo
desc: Lakes, rose gardens, and rollerbladers who never miss. Rent nothing, walk everything, spend zero.

name: El Ateneo Grand Splendid
desc: A century-old theater reborn as a bookstore, café on the stage. Free to enter, dangerous for book budgets.

name: Puente de la Mujer
desc: Puerto Madero's white swoosh of a bridge, best at dusk when the docks glow. A free skyline moment.

name: MALBA
desc: Latin American art heavyweights in a bright modern box. The kind of ten dollars that upgrades your whole personality.

name: Obelisco
desc: The needle in the middle of the widest avenue on earth. Stand there once at night, honking traffic and all. Free forever.
